description: Omnia is a GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform that tracks how AI models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity perceive and cite your brand. Connect to Omnia to query brand visibility metrics, share of voice, sentiment trends, and citation data across LLM outputs. Monitor how your brand compares to competitors in AI-generated responses, track prompt-level performance over time, and pull structured analytics to inform content and positioning strategy.

defaultPrompt: Summarize our AI visibility for the last 7 days. Flag any drops or gains compared to the previous week.
What does our AI visibility look like in the US compared to the UK? Break it down by engine.
Which URLs are cited most often in AI answers for our brand over the last 30 days? Break them down by AI engine.
